A complete analyze run writes findings JSON under the project directory with category and severity in CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW covering claims vs GOAL/IN/OUT/MUST/MUST NOT/VERIFY, clarification contradictions, constitution MUST when constitution.md exists, and unmapped claims or VERIFY
Analyze reads claims JSON, assembled scope-contract, and clarifications decisions; reads constitution.md when that file exists; completes when plan.md and tasks.md are absent
Agents run spec-analyze through a skill file, MCP tools, and a CLI entry point
Modify claims JSON, assembled contract markdown, nodes.yaml, fragment YAML, or constitution.md during an analyze run
Block `/implement` after analyze status is complete or skipped solely because findings contain CRITICAL
